An earlier version split only after periods and therefore attached a citation written after the period to the next sentence. Extractive answers in the "S1. [doc:x] S2. [doc:x]" form then scored 0.5 although they quote the cited document verbatim; that bug produced the old {{cmp.llm_hist.groundedness.baseline|.4f}} baseline. `tests/test_metrics.py` now checks that verbatim extractive output scores 1.0 for both citation placements.
